title: Alchemical Photon Distillery
description: An arcane chemistry lab where the Venice mask serves as a catalytic vessel, the godrays demo acts as a luminous reagent source, and the barn lamp provides focused activation energy. The user must combine, distill, and balance photonic reagents through a multi-step alchemical process governed by energy conservation laws, with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing an Alchemical Photon Distillery lab. Load all three GLB assets via GLTFLoader. Position the godrays_demo model on the left as a 'Luminous Reagent Source' emitting colored light particles. Place the venice_mask center-stage as a 'Catalytic Vessel' — its hollow interior collects reagents. Position the AnisotropyBarnLamp on the right as an 'Activation Lamp' that focuses energy beams onto the mask. Camera: perspective at (0,2,5) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Lighting: ambient at 0.3 intensity plus a point light on the lamp. Implement an energy conservation system: total energy is fixed at 1000 units distributed across three channels (Red, Green, Blue). Display an HUD overlay with sliders for each channel, current energy totals, a step counter, and undo/redo buttons. Interaction steps (10-14 required): (1) Click godrays model to extract a reagent color — spawns a glowing sphere near it. (2) Drag the sphere onto the venice_mask to deposit it. (3) Adjust RGB sliders to tune the deposited reagent's spectral balance (energy redistributes, total stays 1000). (4) Click the barn lamp to fire an activation beam (a raycaster-visible cylinder) at the mask. (5) The mask glows with the mixed color result. (6-8) Repeat extraction-deposit-tune for two more reagent layers, each blending additively. (9) Toggle lamp intensity (three levels) to trigger different reaction thresholds. (10) Click a 'Distill' button to finalize — mask emits particle burst matching final color. (11-12) Optionally undo steps to rebalance and redo. Multi-input coupling: lamp intensity multiplies reagent absorption rate, slider values cross-affect glow color on the mask in real time. Conservation law: RGB energy always sums to 1000; adjusting one slider auto-reduces others proportionally. Store full action history for undo/redo (min 14 states). Show step count and completion percentage.
